meta.title: Loop board
meta.description: What is done when something happens or the time comes: rows hand their entries, events and actions to the loop board, which checks and lists them, and brings four entries of its own (dependency check after a merge, a reminder for what has waited for you too long, the two ends of a GLM peak). It also keeps the entries a person added, and in a process that can reach a session it beats, runs what is due and tells the main agent; /loops and the loop board page of the panel list every entry. The tools through which a person agrees to a new entry are not here yet. On by default.
